description: This file defines the core class HTMLPurifier, which provides functionality to sanitize and filter HTML content to ensure it is safe, standards-compliant, and free from malicious code. The class includes methods for configuring, purifying single or multiple HTML snippets, and managing singleton instances.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier
classes.description: Main class responsible for coordinating the filtering process, managing configuration, filters, and generating purified HTML.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the purifier with a configuration object, or a default if none provided.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds an extra filter object to the purifier (deprecated in favor of configuration directives).

methods.name: purify
methods.description: Filters a single HTML snippet to produce a safe, standards-compliant HTML output.

methods.name: purifyArray
methods.description: Filters an array of HTML snippets.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of HTMLPurifier, optionally creating or replacing it.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Backward compatible method for singleton access, alias for instance().
